Peter Willis,— did you see this tweet from AOC?

A person’s right to control their body is fundamental to human dignity.

But Democrats like Kyrsten Sinema are stopping the Senate from taking action to protect reproductive rights and personal privacy.

We must stand together and fight to protect our freedom, even if corporate Democrats are standing in the way.

Peter Willis, do you agree with the message from AOC that Kyrsten Sinema needs to be held accountable for her support of the filibuster? (https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/5464?t=1012&akid=2897%2E5885482%2E4B7zED)

subject: How should we elect the president?
body:
I am enclosing a survey on a very urgent matter. It will only take a moment of your time, but the topic is vital to our nation
[View this message in your browser](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2z5cs0h8ojrgo2nfb197kms20q9pho7lheu1pttng_rp2ash2s8gb2sbgebjqf99jk1p7fcdkmcqjas3h6gonact66uqrf91ieoob9crl6uie5sj2u3h37cdim9gjepb0msq34s5gslomcdb6mhob2dpkc2pn2tr3eqqr2dbh6sq6appnq9o74oj6e2p6cs74mdhm0shicoqm5cr3cur64phim2p6co70mlhm1o5l64oracdle8gq48bi4bh28or5c9gmcor0c9ie49fg)
This sponsored message from Pro Life Update is on behalf of Hillsdale College [](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2zfqpdth6her324v02vp5mk1d4r1ittdlbvo9jei0_rp22sh2s8i66pb2c5j66o32cjh2bs) Dear Fellow American, I am enclosing a survey on a very urgent matter. It will only take a moment of your time, but the topic is vital to our nation’s future. A movement is growing, led by progressives—but supported by many well-meaning Americans—to change the way we elect our president. In effect, it seeks to do away with the Electoral College as devised by the Framers of our Constitution. That’s why Hillsdale College is conducting a **National Survey on Presidential Selection.** By completing this survey and returning it to me as soon as possible, you will help Hillsdale College more clearly understand the views of mainstream Americans concerning this issue—views we will make available to policymakers and opinion leaders. You can complete the **National Survey on Presidential Selection** by using the link below: **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/electoral-college-survey](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2z0oscc94k0ugtqfjnli0j1umpflrnkao2rdiq3lg_rp22sh2s8i66pb2c5j66o32cjh2bs)** For most of our nation’s history, the Electoral College, as devised by the Framers of our Constitution, was not controversial. Indeed, it was considered essential to preserving free and representative government. **But today, more than a dozen states have joined together in an attempt to undermine this constitutional bulwark of liberty.** This movement to undermine the Constitution has grown largely because of the failure of America’s schools to provide young people with a proper grounding in American civics—too many Americans simply don’t understand the importance of the Constitution, including the Electoral College, to liberty. Because of this, Hillsdale College has expanded its educational mission on behalf of liberty nationwide, directly teaching **millions** of Americans in all 50 states. These efforts, which aim to counter the Left’s domination over most of our schools, include:
* **Teaching** millions of citizens nationwide through free online courses, such as “Constitution 101” and “The Great American Story: A Land of Hope;”
* **Reaching** over 5.6 million households and businesses nationwide with _Imprimis_ , Hillsdale’s free digest of liberty;
* **Promoting** constitutional education through social media outlets popular with young people;
* **Sending** millions of pocket-size copies of America’s founding documents to citizens and K-12 schools across America, as well as to members of our armed forces; and
* **Restoring** excellence to K-12 education through Hillsdale’s Barney Charter School Initiative, which launches and provides guidance to classical K-12 charter schools nationwide.

Your answers to the **National Survey on Presidential Selection** will help Hillsdale form the most effective strategy to educate millions of Americans about the importance of the Constitution to liberty—including the importance of the Electoral College. **And this is especially important in this critical time for America’s future.** So please share your views on this urgent topic by completing our **National Survey on Presidential Selection** and returning it to me as soon as possible. It will only take a few minutes of your time. **You can take the survey using this secure link I've provided below:** **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/electoral-college-survey](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2zclff16gbqkm5pm3nptik5pns4konrum0h731cvo_rp22sh2s8i66pb2c5j66o32cjh2bs)** And after you take your survey, I hope you will also consider supporting Hillsdale College with a tax-deductible gift. Since 1844, Hillsdale has been “pursuing truth and defending liberty.” Today, it does so through its extensive educational outreach efforts, while refusing to accept ONE PENNY of government funding—not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans. The support of private citizens like you is essential to our work. Please represent your state and take the **National Survey on Presidential Selection today**. Thank you for your time and attention—and for your friendship and support of liberty. Warm regards, Larry P. Arnn President, Hillsdale College Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844

| | From the Desk of Dr. Ben Carson: Hello, I don’t believe the majority of the public really knows what is being taught to our children and grandchildren. They assume they are taught the same lessons we learned growing up—that America is a land of freedom and opportunity where anyone has a chance at success. From what I’ve seen, this isn’t always the case. [**However, I want to know what you’ve seen.**](http://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2z40615qvcog7u1rkspm8882jbaglgkj3njm2v140_rp22sh2s8i66pb2c5j66o32chh2bs) [](http://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2zbanjeh7k7pm20kj09mt7mqrcnsg6qrtjgsbvm30_rp22sh2s8i66pb2c5j66o32chh2bs)
_Dr. Ben Carson, Founder and Chairman of American Cornerstone Institute_ I believe that **children as young as elementary age are being taught to reject our American values.** They are told that our Founding Fathers were massively flawed and that it overshadows the nation they built. They hear that our Constitution is “out of date” and needs to be “modernized.” Progressives are rewriting our nation’s history and they are doing it with our youngest and most vulnerable. We cannot let this happen! This year I’m going to be meeting with political leaders and educational “experts” across the country. **I’m going to make sure people know what is really happening in our schools.** I want to be able to share with them the thoughts of people who are closest to the issue. [**Specifically, I would like to include your thoughts.**](http://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2zupr52vu164kknqsqf2v34pchhfjcmi071to5mo8_rp22sh2s8i66pb2c5j66o32chh2bs) The American Cornerstone Institute, a nonprofit I recently founded, has created a unique survey. We’re trying to gauge the state of America’s Educational System by surveying people like you. I’d like to ask you to give me 2 minutes of your time so we can better understand the problems that exist in our educational system. You can access the survey here...

[https://offers.americancornerstone.org/education_survey/](http://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2zggdsaja89gsb24ljndosm2oss03id5f927fpb18_rp22sh2s8i66pb2c5j66o32chh2bs) Thank you for your consideration. Regards,
Dr. Ben Carson

body:

[View this message in your browser](http://e.deroymurdock.com/rd/9z2z77ipkot3t2p26m25037nbov6qiu2euvn8md7dg8_rp2ash2s8gb2sbgebjqf99jk4qj4ttkumqn4s9nmorb79hnmmrq8cjm62qb6t9nkjhf4onge1rrbc5he6qr7d70s2qmfd35mep72p76maq3asbic8rb6dlj66oj6db4mdij0puie1p68dhgm9j74t1hepge1d3563gbacb4spj6ccdgmdh60slmcoq61cr0cuobapbi46h22sh2s8i66pb2c5j66o32c1h2bs)
|
---
| | From the Desk of Dr. Ben Carson: Hello, I feel like our culture has forgotten—or ignored—some very important and basic lessons when it comes to the development of human life. Our society has been infected by an anti-life ideology, treating its most vulnerable members as disposable objects. Abortion that was once thought of as a last resort in a medical emergency has become the new normal. Medicine tells us that life begins at the moment of conception. It also tells us when an unborn baby develops a heartbeat, brainwaves, and nervous system. Yet, despite all of this, the unborn are not treated as though they are alive or even human. **As a surgeon, I have operated on infants pre-birth. I can assure you that they are very much alive.** [](http://e.deroymurdock.com/rd/9z2z81ntue28kvjfnsh9l474q2tj517d17mk1883qa8_rp22sh2s8i66pb2c5j66o32c1h2bs)
_Dr. Ben Carson, Founder and Chairman of American Cornerstone Institute_ Life is a precious gift that has been given to us from our creator. No person is disposable, and every life is precious according to Him. I believe that everyone deserves life, even those who have been denied this right by our society. I believe that together we can make a difference and bring dignity and a voice to the unborn. I also believe that I’m not alone in this belief. I believe that you believe that too. I’ve started working with a group of like-minded individuals who are looking to change our culture. We want to build a society that values life but that takes people like you and I making a commitment. The first step is clearly stating what we believe and what we are willing to do to protect the lives of the unborn. [**Will you join me today and stand up for those who cannot do it for themselves?**](http://e.deroymurdock.com/rd/9z2z53ruo2s5nsj34botknmr4s8c1nq4hrr13grga1o_rp22sh2s8i66pb2c5j66o32c1h2bs) I’ve created a new pro-life pledge; I’d love your support. Would you read the pledge below to see if you align with our shared goals and are willing to commit to fighting for the lives of the unborn? [https://offers.americancornerstone.org/pro-life-statement/](http://e.deroymurdock.com/rd/9z2zdkcb9lsksfkblmcff2m5715tfsjqmtk34mndrsg_rp22sh2s8i66pb2c5j66o32c1h2bs) Regards,

body:

Dear Fellow Conservative, Gas prices have risen dramatically since the Biden administration took office, and I’m sure you’ve felt the pinch at the pump just like the rest of your fellow Americans. There’s no doubt in my mind that our nation’s citizens are in need of relief. But instead, President Biden has throttled U.S. energy production. And he has trapped much of our nation’s vast energy reserves behind a wall of bureaucratic red tape. That’s why I’m sending you this email today. I’d like to hear how the Biden administration’s energy policies have affected you and your family. [**Would you be willing to share your thoughts in this brief 8 question survey?**](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c21028%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=uK%2fO%2blvaMfqGJl5RcaZPog&sysid=1) By doing so, you will help The Heritage Foundation understand what people like you think--and use your answers to fight back against the Biden administration’s radical anti-energy agenda. The survey should only take a few minutes of your time, but your opinion is incredibly valuable. **You can get started right now using this secure link:[https://secured.heritage.org/energy-independence-survey/](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c21029%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=DdV%2fZ7USyTsYl9le35ly0g&sysid=1)** Thank you so much for your time. subject: Revealed: Plan to Transform America
body:
| **Why are Bezos and Musk Investing Billions to ‘Transform’ the American Economy? And What Does It Mean for Your Money?** Something strange is happening behind the scenes in our financial system. Right now, the mainstream media is completely ignoring what might be the most important story in the financial world that nobody is talking about. Amid the distractions caused by conflicts overseas, shortages, and inflation, Treasury Secretary Janet Yellen recently took the stage at an event called COP26 in Glasgow, Scotland to address some of the world’s most powerful people, including:
* U.S. President, Joe Biden...
* British Prime Minister, Boris Johnson...
* Canadian Prime Minister, Justin Trudeau...
* French President, Emmanuel Macron...
* ... and many more...

From the stage, Yellen called for world leaders to commit to a [$150 trillion ‘global transition’ of our economy. ](http://click.greatamericaupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=41%7c61935%7c612934%7c1%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=9%2bU%2fJsxMwy8KjstN1ZWUvA&sysid=1) Since then, Bank of America has committed, along with 131 countries, 234 cities, and 695 of the world’s biggest companies. Several billionaires, led by Jeff Bezos and Elon Musk have invested in this ‘transformation’ as well. What is it that Yellen, Biden, Trudeau, Bezos and Musk are pushing for with their ‘transformation’? And what does it mean for your money? Investigative journalist and renowned economist, Nomi Prins, who predicted the 2008 market meltdown has followed the money... And [what she’s discovered is startling. ](http://click.greatamericaupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=41%7c61936%7c612934%7c1%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=JYdLWcQNG9l4X7JIh42iaw&sysid=1) It has nothing to do with a market crash... a new reserve currency... or the end of fiat. Prins says: **“While most Americans are distracted by mainstream media headlines, I’ve found evidence the elites are spending $150 trillion to ‘transform’ our economy into something we didn’t vote on ... didn’t ask for... and very few are prepared for.** **In essence, we’re about to see a stranger, more extreme ‘new normal’ in America.** **Most people will be shocked when they see what happens in the months ahead.”** Prins considers this transformation so urgent, she has agreed to sit down for an interview to get her message in front of as many Americans as possible. For now, there’s no cost to watch. [Go here to see how this ‘transformation’ could affect you - and find out what it means for your money.](http://click.greatamericaupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=41%7c61937%7c612934%7c1%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=Ap3ehN2Sr3Dn7PH7fjZ%2baQ&sysid=1) [](http://click.greatamericaupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=41%7c61938%7c612934%7c1%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=JG4dFYNFrNDdC3iTnw2BCA&sysid=1)

Peter, One of the reasons I launched this campaign to become Maryland’s next Democratic governor is my dedication to making life in our state more equitable. Growing up in an unstable household, I know how challenging life can be when families don’t have the basic resources to thrive. I lost my mother when I was 8 and lived with my father, who had undiagnosed Alzheimer’s, until he passed away when I was 12. | May 13, 2022
Dear Friend,
I've got a quiz for you. It's only five questions, and you're going to ace it -- promise.
---
| 1\. A generation ago, New York developed the most effective crime fighting tactics in U. S. history. Broken Windows policing reduced crime more than 90% in some areas. Law enforcement officials from all over the world flocked to New York to learn what we were doing right. Would you:

* A: Keep Broken Windows policing?
* B: Bring back failed policies that almost destroyed New York?

---
| 2. New York is the most expensive state in America. More than 1.2 million New Yorkers -- and a countless number of job-providing businesses -- have fled New York for more affordable states. Should we:

* A: Cut taxes and spending to give New Yorkers relief and attract jobs?
* B: Raise taxes, fees, and spending to make living here even more expensive?

---
| 3. Illegal immigrants are arriving at our southern border by the tens of thousands. Do we:

* A: Demand our federal and state governments follow the law and secure our border?
* B: Give those here illegally free iPhones, secretly fly them from the southern border to New York in the dead of night, and then bus them into communities that have no idea they're coming?

---
| 4\. Women's sports have made extraordinary strides in the 50 years since Title IX was enacted. Do we:
* A: Protect girls' and women's sports.
* B: Make girls and women compete against biological males in contests and for athletic scholarships?

---
| 5\. America is the most successful and aspirational nation on earth. Do we:

* A: Educate kids about the American Dream and equip them to achieve it.
* B: Teach kids to hate America and divide them by race.

---
| Congratulations! If you answered "A" on any of these questions, you're officially normal (as opposed to progressives like Governor Kathy Hochul who would check off "B" on each of these questions.)

Dear Fellow American, Young people today grow up being told that their perception of reality is a matter of perspective. Recently, they are even told that women can choose to be men and men women. This denial of objective reality--including a denial of an objective good--is destructive of proper education, of religious faith, and of free government. Largely as an antidote to this destructive force, Hillsdale College is releasing its latest free online course, “C.S. Lewis on Christianity.” Taught by Michael Ward, a visiting distinguished fellow at Hillsdale and a professor of theology at Oxford University, this seven-lecture course covers Lewis’s philosophical defense of an objective good and his demonstration of its fulfillment in Christianity. **I am writing today to ask if you would consider helping us meet our goal of raising $500,000 by midnight on May 16, so we can promote this new online course effectively, especially to young people.** ** ** Hillsdale produces its free online courses, as it does all its work, while refusing to accept government funding--not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans. We are entirely dependent on private donations. With your tax-deductible gift today, we can enroll tens of thousands of young people in this new free online course and expand Hillsdale’s other outreach efforts. Please help us reach our $500,000 goal. I’ve included a secure link for you to make your tax-deductible gift below: **[https://secured.hillsdale.edu/hillsdale/cs-lewis-christianity](http://click.greatamericaupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=41%7c61931%7c612934%7c1%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=2uzvRGTr%2b0t6oRDKw%2bBNVA&sysid=1)** Thank you for your friendship and support. People told me I didn't belong in the force, but I risked my life to protect my community, working the night shifts as a beat cop. Years later, I became the first woman to serve as Orlando's chief of police.

[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/45260150/345175160/1395796377?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDMvMS82ODcxNCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJmYWM5ZWIwMi1jNWQyLWVjMTEtYjY1Ni0yODE4NzhiOGMzMmYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=YYvDRYJjuWj4B7roAUFS9MrVkUFP8YYrwORSjWEZ2xE=)

Dear Peter,
As the 112th Tennessee Legislative Session has come to a close, we wanted to give you a brief rundown of some highlights this legislative season!
This session was dominated by Republicans shoehorning egregious, hateful, and short-sided bills; take a look. ⬇️
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/45260152/345175165/1395796377?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDMvMS82ODcxNCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJmYWM5ZWIwMi1jNWQyLWVjMTEtYjY1Ni0yODE4NzhiOGMzMmYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=YYvDRYJjuWj4B7roAUFS9MrVkUFP8YYrwORSjWEZ2xE=)
Here was the worst of the worst. 🛑

\- Gov. Lee and many of his close allies in the legislature continued to prioritize the (illegal) school voucher program which prioritizes theocratic-private schools instead of quality education for all. 🏫
\- Women’s Rights & bodily autonomy were on the chopping block as Republicans in the legislature introduced a “Texas-Style” abortion ban interfering with federal government rulings, and also makes no special cases for rape nor incest. ♀️
\- Those who are homeless now have targets on their back as law enforcement officers can arrest anyone unhoused sleeping in public spaces and charge them with a misdemeanor. 🚨
\- Trans kids were hit even harder than previously before, as Republicans made it increasingly more difficult for anyone non-gender conforming to play in recreational sports in Tennessee. ⚽

[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/45260154/345175166/1395796377?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDMvMS82ODcxNCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJmYWM5ZWIwMi1jNWQyLWVjMTEtYjY1Ni0yODE4NzhiOGMzMmYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=YYvDRYJjuWj4B7roAUFS9MrVkUFP8YYrwORSjWEZ2xE=)

Despite the lunacy of these bills, Democrats were able to get some solid legislation passed! 🟢

\- The Black History Act ensures Black history and related curriculum be taught from 5th to 8th grade. 📘
\- The CROWN Act prevents employers from adopting policy discriminating on the basis of natural hairstyle—a huge win for workplace equality within Tennessee. 💇🏾♀️
\- The Anti-Shackling Act was passed, ensuring pregnant inmates are not restrained. 🍼

[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/45260155/345175167/1395796377?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDMvMS82ODcxNCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJmYWM5ZWIwMi1jNWQyLWVjMTEtYjY1Ni0yODE4NzhiOGMzMmYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=YYvDRYJjuWj4B7roAUFS9MrVkUFP8YYrwORSjWEZ2xE=)

As Democrats continue to make solid strides towards building a better Tennessee, it seems as if our counterparts are doing quite the opposite.
[Help us restore sanity to Tennessee; as our colleagues go low, we’ll continue to take the high route for everyday working people!](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/45260158/345175168/1395796377?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDMvMS82ODcxNCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJmYWM5ZWIwMi1jNWQyLWVjMTEtYjY1Ni0yODE4NzhiOGMzMmYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=YYvDRYJjuWj4B7roAUFS9MrVkUFP8YYrwORSjWEZ2xE=)

clean_body: We wanted to give you a brief rundown of some highlights this legislative season! = = Dear Peter, As the 112th Tennessee Legislative Session has come to a close, we wanted to give you a brief rundown of some highlights this legislative season! This session was dominated by Republicans shoehorning egregious, hateful, and short-sided bills; take a look. ⬇️ = Here was the worst of the worst. 🛑 \- Gov. Lee and many of his close allies in the legislature continued to prioritize the (illegal) school voucher program which prioritizes theocratic-private schools instead of quality education for all. 🏫 \- Women’s Rights & bodily autonomy were on the chopping block as Republicans in the legislature introduced a “Texas-Style” abortion ban interfering with federal government rulings, and also makes no special cases for rape nor incest. ♀️ \- Those who are homeless now have targets on their back as law enforcement officers can arrest anyone unhoused sleeping in public spaces and charge them with a misdemeanor. 🚨 \- Trans kids were hit even harder than previously before, as Republicans made it increasingly more difficult for anyone non-gender conforming to play in recreational sports in Tennessee. ⚽ = Despite the lunacy of these bills, Democrats were able to get some solid legislation passed! 🟢 \- The Black History Act ensures Black history and related curriculum be taught from 5th to 8th grade. 📘 \- The CROWN Act prevents employers from adopting policy discriminating on the basis of natural hairstyle—a huge win for workplace equality within Tennessee. 💇🏾♀️ \- The Anti-Shackling Act was passed, ensuring pregnant inmates are not restrained. 🍼 = As Democrats continue to make solid strides towards building a better Tennessee, it seems as if our counterparts are doing quite the opposite. = Thank you, Tennessee House Democratic Caucus Chairman = Paid for by Tennessee House Democratic Caucus, Jesse Chism Treasurer Tennessee House Democratic Caucus P. name: Steven Olikara
subject: Finding the jazz in democracy.
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Olikara for Senate
body:
Image of Olikara campaign logo with photo of Steven Olikara and link to campaign website:[https://nvlupin.blob.core.windows.net/images/van/NGP/NGP30/1/90801/images/OfS%20logo%20w%20headshot.png]
[https://www.stevenolikara.com]

Image of Steven Olikara playing with Nemesis at District1 Brewing Company in Stevens Point:
[https://nvlupin.blob.core.windows.net/images/van/NGP/NGP30/1/90801/images/2_Steven_playing_with_Nemesis2.jpeg]

Dear Peter,

We were excited to be in Stevens Point last week at District 1 Brewing Company [http://www.district1brewing.com/] , a community focused taproom, to talk with voters and share our vision for a new, more inclusive form of politics. While we were there, we also collected signatures for our nomination papers. We need to collect 2,000 signatures by June 1st to get our name on the primary ballot — please reply “YES” to this email if you can help gather signatures from your friends and family.

While we were at District 1, I was delighted to have the opportunity to play with Nemesis [https://www.facebook.com/Nemesis-103598422318913/], a local band. We covered Jimi Hendrix and Black Sabbath and connected on the need to get big money out of our politics and make government work for all of us. The conversations with Democrats, Republicans, and Independents at the bar reminded me of why I got into politics in the first place.

Image of Steven Olikara and Jake Reynolds of Nemesis holding up their guitars and smiling. Image includes link to campaign donation page.
[https://nvlupin.blob.core.windows.net/images/van/NGP/NGP30/1/90801/images/Steven_Jake_Nemesis.jpeg]
[https://secure.actblue.com/donate/teamolikara?refcode=0513email]

Before I ever thought about getting involved in public service, music was my first passion. Growing up in Brookfield, I played in every kind of band you can imagine. I picked up the guitar in third grade, the drums in fourth grade and started my first rock band when I was in fifth grade.

It’s no secret that Milwaukee is the most racially and politically segregated metro area in the U.S. Playing in diverse bands gave me opportunities to learn about and connect with people from all different backgrounds. Making music has made my life richer and helped me bridge racial, cultural and political divides.

Image of Steven Olikara playing guitar and singing with link to campaign donation page:
[https://nvlupin.blob.core.windows.net/images/van/NGP/NGP30/1/90801/images/Steven_Singing_with_Guitar.jpeg]
[https://secure.actblue.com/donate/teamolikara?refcode=0513email]

What I learned through these experiences became my fundamental DNA in politics: when you create open spaces rooted in dignity, respect, and empathy, what you create in that space is more dynamic, more creative - it’s better. Jazz is a call-and-response art form that relies on listening and builds on ideas from other people, just like democracy can be at its best. This is the vision of our campaign: to create a new, more inclusive form of politics based on listening to one another. Please help us share our vision and introduce our campaign to more Wisconsin voters by contributing now. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/teamolikara?refcode=0513email]

Button that says, "Chip in to create a more inclusive Wisconsin." with link to campaign donation page:
[https://secure.actblue.com/donate/teamolikara?refcode=0513email]

I believe this will be a movement that transforms American politics and passes on a stronger democracy to our children and grandchildren. And, any time people tell you, ‘This is impossible. It’s too hard to do, ‘just remind them what Nelson Mandela said: ‘It always seems impossible until it’s done.’

With Hope,
Steven

We need your help to gather the signatures necessary to get on the ballot for the August 9th primary. Please reply “YES” to this email if you can help gather signatures from your friends and family and please consider making a contribution to our campaign to ensure dignity for all.
Button that says, "Support Our Campaign" with link to campaign donation page:
[https://secure.actblue.com/donate/teamolikara?refcode=0513email]

Paid for by Olikara for Senate.

Twitter logo with link to Steven Olikara's Twitter profile: [https://twitter.com/stevenolikara]
Instagram logo with link to Steven Olikara's Instagram profile: [https://www.instagram.com/stevenolikara/]
TikTok logo with link to Steven Olikara's TikTok profile: [https://www.tiktok.com/@stevenolikara]

Olikara for Senate
P.O. Box 510216
Milwaukee, WI 53203
United States

Despite all the noise, misinformation and disinformation, voting has never been more convenient and secure in Pennsylvania.
Pennsylvania citizens have the freedom to choose whether to vote in person or by mail. With the May 17th Primary Election approaching next week, know your rights as a Pennsylvania voter [https://www.facebook.com/NewPennsylvaniaProject/photos/a.124297133129390/332939688931799/?__tn__=%2CO*F] so that you're well-prepared to make your voice heard in 2022.
NPP IN THE NEWS
Before you head into the weekend, check out this roundup of news you could use.
Kadida Kenner speaks during a protest against the Supreme Court's imminent overturning of Roe v. Wade, at the courthouse in Media, Tuesday, May 3, 2022. [https://d15k2d11r6t6rl.cloudfront.net/public/users/Integrators/04eaa6b2-88f4-43b4-b978-7bb0708f5838/6B4A6345516F426732456A72562F5A5A4873535450646D3238416E5A6C76694C3055344974646C45514F6430463654586D45436E35684C64306D4E7436336477/editor_images/OCPN7HBXXZGYVH7DFCVFONXDZQ.webp]
Kadida Kenner speaks during a protest against the Supreme Court's imminent overturning of Roe v. Wade, at the courthouse in Media, Tuesday, May 3, 2022.
What Supreme Court leak confirmed: This is no longer the America we grew up in
Knowing the Supreme Court was likely to undo abortion rights didn't make the news easier for protesters who barely recognize their country.
Nearby at the booming microphone, NPP executive director Kadida Kenner voiced similar concerns in her speech.
“It starts with the overturning of settled law, which is Roe v. Wade, but it doesn’t end there. This is the start, because if you can overturn this settled law, then you can overturn Brown v. Board. You can overturn Obergefell [which legalized gay marriage]. We had it rammed down our throat that the far right did not want an activist court. How do you explain this?!”
Read the full article [https://www.inquirer.com/opinion/supreme-court-abortion-leak-reaction-20220505.html] in the Philadelphia Inquirer.
[https://d15k2d11r6t6rl.cloudfront.net/public/users/Integrators/04eaa6b2-88f4-43b4-b978-7bb0708f5838/6B4A6345516F426732456A72562F5A5A4873535450646D3238416E5A6C76694C3055344974646C45514F6430463654586D45436E35684C64306D4E7436336477/editor_images/FSFYZzJXoAAFV1P.jpeg]
Bob Casey is one of the last ‘pro-life’ Democrats. The Supreme Court decision is going to test his views.
NPP's Kadida Kenner also featured in the Philadelphia Inquirer [https://www.inquirer.com/politics/pennsylvania/sen-bob-casey-abortion-supreme-court-decision-20220503.html] praising Casey on reproductive rights, saying the senator needs to cast aside his personal views and focus on upholding a popular law that most Pennsylvanians support.
"We all have our personal Constitutions,” Kenner said, “but I also believe that Senator Casey can see this from the legal standpoint. [Roe] has been the law of the land for 50 years ... and he needs to continue to honor the will of his constituency.”
Weekend read: We need Bucks County youth to not just vote, but build political power.
C heck out Kadida Kenner’s debut column with the Bucks County Beacon, [https://buckscountybeacon.com/2022/05/in-pennsylvania-democracy-only-works-when-youth-are-politically-engaged-and-voting/] "In Pennsylvania, Democracy Only Works When Youth Are Politically Engaged and Voting."

The voter turnout gap may be even bigger than we think
Demographic change continues to steadily reshape the American electorate, but the barriers to emerging groups gaining political power commensurate with their growing numbers may be even greater than previously understood, according to a new analysis of population and voting trends that's stirring private debate in Democratic circles.
Read more in Microsoft Start [https://www.msn.com/en-us/news/politics/the-voter-turnout-gap-may-be-even-bigger-than-we-think/ar-AAWRhva?ocid=msedgntp&cvid=376e01f42a2541518a6ad41004eac1bf]
What happens if Roe v. Wade is overturned? In Pa., the answer depends on the November governor’s race.
The outcome of the Pennsylvania governor’s race could determine the future of legal abortion access in the state, which is uncertain following the leak of a draft U.S. Supreme Court opinion that would overturn Roe v. Wade .
Read more in Spotlight PA [https://www.spotlightpa.org/news/2022/05/roe-v-wade-pa-governor-race-abortion-access/?fbclid=IwAR19IhTJZBuFCo-QQ4iYUQJ-__dIkeoHcZ5oGXcTRdSKl_giMlyMFsMQVRU]

Pennsylvania’s 2022 U.S. Senate race is one of the most competitive elections in the country and could help determine control of the Senate following this year’s midterm elections. Peter: New Mexico communities raised me – from the moment I took my very first steps to the day I walked across the stage to accept my college diploma.
Growing up in New Mexico, I met friends and neighbors who were kind, innovative, and resilient – but I also saw that our elected officials could be doing more to harness our state's potential and support families.
That's why I dedicated my entire life to giving back to the state that raised me, first as the Director of Aging, then as a U.S. Congresswoman, and now as the first Democratic Hispanic woman to become Governor.
**Since I took office, I've delivered real, meaningful change. I took bold action on climate change, signed a law to provide free higher education for all, legalized cannabis, and more. But to continue passing our progressive agenda, I need your help.**
**[There are less than six months until my reelection, and I need to hit my $75,000 mid-month goal to defend myself from GOP attack ads: If you're with me, will you donate $5 right now to keep New Mexico blue?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/45263275/345186773/-1540418300?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&refcode=jtk1254-fr-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjEvMS84Nzc2OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJmYWJmMmQzNS1jOWQyLWVjMTEtYjY1Ni0yODE4NzhiOGMzMmYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=kaAt_Uq_n2Cm_hEx0q2STHpIx6eq9VeBTT7RY8yO5pg=)**

body:
Here’s how I'm fighting back

| | | Kirsten said I could check in, Team.** ** I know it’s been a tough week or so in the wake of reports about the Supreme Court planning to overturn Roe v. Wade. I want you to know that I am doing everything I can to protect Roe v. Wade and the right to abortion–but I need your help. I am talking to anyone and everyone in the Senate to build support for legislation to codify Roe v. Wade. Republicans blocked the Women’s Health Protection Act, again, but I’m not giving up the fight and will keep pushing with everything I have. **But to put it simply, we need to protect pro-choice Democrats in the Senate in November–and elect more of us–to secure the right to abortion once and for all.** _**[That’s where you come in – I’m up for reelection this year and I need your support as I continue the fight to protect reproductive rights. Will you chip in $5, or whatever you can, now?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/45263705/345188507/2103550919?refcode=jtk3459-bu-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTkvMS83MjcyMiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI1ODYwZjQwZC1jYWQyLWVjMTEtYjY1Ni0yODE4NzhiOGMzMmYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=UuG7vFp-Ns1UqwyMRDVNkSkxe9AardJL8IPFQKhqQPY=)**_ It’s going to take all of us standing together and fighting back like we never have before. I will continue to lead this fight, but I need you in my corner and I need help getting the word out about how much this matters. | Dear Friend,
I can't believe that just 7 weeks from today we'll cast our ballots in the Utah Republican Primary for the U.S. Senate. I'm hoping over the next 7 weeks I can earn your trust and reinforce why I'm the best person to represent Utah in Washington, D.C.
The time for flashy turns of phrase and quick one liners is over. We need real conversations about what change in Washington means for Utah, and why I am the change and voice Utah needs.
Honestly, we heard the reason today when President Biden placed the blame for inflation and a troubled economic future on Republicans. Unbelievable. He spent time on a partisan distraction and not talking about real solutions. More of the same old, same old we expect from D.C.'s career elites.
But how does changing our Republican senator in Utah affect what a Democrat-controlled Presidency, Senate, and House does?
It's simple.
We need new voices speaking truth in clear terms. Then we need real action to ensure those ideas are put in motion.
Nothing is working right now in D.C. Nothing.
U.S. citizens are a partisan rope in a never-ending tug-of-war. That rope is fraying. We are tired of the senseless fighting and division.
That's why I'm running, and that's why I'm asking for your vote. We need to get D.C. to work for us - We the People - and we need new voices with new thinking to make it happen.
It really is that simple.
Please follow our Republican Renaissance on our social media platforms today and vote for me, Ally Isom, on June 28th.
Thanks and let's talk again soon, Ally

---
**Barletta recommended by FOP Lodge #54**
---
Former mayor and congressman Lou Barletta, leading Republican candidate for governor of Pennsylvania, was today recommended by the Board of Directors of the Brady Paul Memorial Lodge #54 of the Pennsylvania Fraternal Order of Police, which represents Butler, Beaver, Mercer, Lawrence, and Armstrong counties. The FOP lodge, Board of Directors said they recommended Barletta because of his dedication to supporting public safety.

Brady Paul Memorial Lodge #54 Board of Directors issued the following statement:

“It is apparent that Lou Barletta is the leading candidate when it comes to enforcing the law, supporting police, and protecting public safety. He has a long history of standing up for what is lawful, and his dependability is beyond question., We are proud to offer our strong recommendation for Lou Barletta to be the next governor of Pennsylvania.”

Barletta issued the following statement:

“As a former mayor, I know exactly how important police are to communities and when I am governor, I will always give law enforcement officers the support and resources they need to do their jobs. We will no longer let violent criminals roam free in our streets because police have been undermined, we will crack down on ‘sanctuary cities’ which give safe haven to illegal immigrants, and we will let our citizens know that help has arrived. I will be a governor for all Pennsylvanians, and they will know that common sense has returned to Harrisburg.”

clean_body: | | | | Barletta recommended by FOP Lodge #54 Former mayor and congressman Lou Barletta, leading Republican candidate for governor of Pennsylvania, was today recommended by the Board of Directors of the Brady Paul Memorial Lodge #54 of the Pennsylvania Fraternal Order of Police, which represents Butler, Beaver, Mercer, Lawrence, and Armstrong counties. The FOP lodge, Board of Directors said they recommended Barletta because of his dedication to supporting public safety. Brady Paul Memorial Lodge #54 Board of Directors issued the following statement: “It is apparent that Lou Barletta is the leading candidate when it comes to enforcing the law, supporting police, and protecting public safety. He has a long history of standing up for what is lawful, and his dependability is beyond question., We are proud to offer our strong recommendation for Lou Barletta to be the next governor of Pennsylvania.” Barletta issued the following statement: “As a former mayor, I know exactly how important police are to communities and when I am governor, I will always give law enforcement officers the support and resources they need to do their jobs. We will no longer let violent criminals roam free in our streets because police have been undermined, we will crack down on ‘sanctuary cities’ which give safe haven to illegal immigrants, and we will let our citizens know that help has arrived. I will be a governor for all Pennsylvanians, and they will know that common sense has returned to Harrisburg.” | | | | ==

Please join us as we launch our Parents for Diehl Coalition with a rally in support of parents and their rights:

name: Gwen Moore
subject: Roe v. Wade is personal to me
disclaimer_text: Paid for and Authorized by Gwen Moore for Congress
body:
Hi there Peter, it's Congresswoman Gwen Moore.

I’m old enough to remember life before Roe v. Wade.

I hustled up money and used the women’s health fund to travel to New York to get an abortion. For me, a poor Black woman, that was the only way I could receive abortion care.
I never want young women to experience what I or others went through.

But the news this week that the Supreme Court intends to overturn Roe v. Wade is chilling. And it is now up to Congress to act to protect abortion rights.

My friend Mandela Barnes is running in one of the most important Senate races in the country. And if we can get him elected, he will be the deciding vote in the Senate to end the filibuster and pass legislation to codify Roe v. Wade into law.

That's why I am asking you today:

Can you please make a $10 contribution to Mandela Barnes' campaign today? Mandela is prepared to fight for abortion rights and end the filibuster in the Senate, and he urgently needs your support to win this race: https://secure.actblue.com/donate/mb-gm

I've been around long enough to have seen people’s health ruined with self-abortions. I've known people who have died from self-abortions. And I've seen people die because they needed an abortion, because they had a bad heart, but they gave birth anyway.

People need to understand that it won't stop with eliminating a woman's right to choose.

This expected Supreme Court decision will impinge on every other unenumerated right. It would put on the chopping block the right for same-sex couples to marry, the right to access birth control, and so much more.

Ahead of November, we ought to put a target on every single Senate seat that is up for re-election. Because it is the Senate that is holding up the important bill that we passed in the House – the Women's Health Protection Act.

Here's some of what that bill would accomplish:
-Establish a statutory right for health care professionals to provide abortion care
-Establish the right for patients to receive care, free from medically unnecessary restrictions that single out abortion care
-Allow abortion after fetal viability if the patient's health is at risk

If we can elect Mandela Barnes to the Senate and defend the Democratic majority, we can pass this important legislation and protect abortion rights for women across the country.

That's why I'm asking you one more time:

Can you please make a $10 contribution to Mandela Barnes' campaign for U.S. Senate today? This race is as important as they come, and it's going to require all of us coming together to flip Wisconsin's Senate seat: https://secure.actblue.com/donate/mb-gm

Thank you for reading, and thank you for all you've done to support Mandela in this campaign.

name: Craig Morgan
subject: With faith in God and a servant’s heart…
body:
This is Craig Morgan. You may recognize me from the country music stage or CBS's new reality survival show, Beyond The Edge. Bu
[View this message in your browser](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2z1kmor8e86omjuudck2f3tiic2qdkt194no15e18_rp2ash2s8gb2sbgebjqf99jksrr0s3iekr79c9l6eon9d1hmej3fddnkgp7cc5kmdqjf972u9hf6pbn6uojccdk6cq74srlc2rj8cj6esp6cdpje6ojcsb3clh6csjhe1i72shm6urt4s3icgr31cj6e9q32tj0s2q6ac70mkom9pj6coor1cr2c1p30pjhmipm1ptgmlin48d245p25oh4cdim4ob5c3im8p324no)
It's more than a home.

| Dear Fellow Patriot,

This is Craig Morgan. You may recognize me from the country music stage or CBS's new reality survival show, _Beyond The Edge._

But as a 17-year veteran of the U.S. Army, there's nothing more important to me than serving God, serving my family, and serving my country.

And right now, thousands of the veterans who've come home from combat and the first responders who've risked their lives defending our communities need your help.

That's why I want to introduce you to Operation Finally Home – a non-profit organization doing God's work by providing custom-built homes and loving communities to the heroes who risked their lives fighting for our freedom.

I know that we probably haven't met... but will you please do me the favor of reading this e-mail from my friend Rusty Carroll at Operation Finally Home?

Rusty and his team need your help to provide safe housing for our wounded, ill, or injured military veterans and first responders.

And after personally witnessing how many lives they've changed over the past few years, I'd be remiss if I didn't at least ask you for this small favor.

God Bless,

Craig Morgan
U.S. Army Combat Veteran, 101st and 82nd Airborne Division
Recipient, Army's Outstanding Civilian Service Medal
Ambassador, Operation Finally Home
#1 Country Recording Artist
Inductee, Grand Ole Opry

* * *
Begin Forwarded Message:

From: Rusty Carroll
Subject: With faith in God and a servant's heart

[](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2z4t85rgsa0t1q7l8kqda3cmfndfoa44a8qvgh1k8_rp22sh2s8i66pb2c5im1pb4chh2bs)

That's a photo of 20-year-old Marine LCpl Steven Schulz.

Even in that little snapshot, you can see his strength and how he's ready to take on the world.

[](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2zc0c76jistoo080biobssbqf9nd6l9agabl88djo_rp22sh2s8i66pb2c5im1pb4chh2bs)

That's an image of Steven after his service in Iraq.

A roadside bomb destroyed the Humvee Steven was traveling in, leaving him bound to a wheelchair with severe and permanent brain injuries.

Immediately after the accident, Steven's mom took months off from work to move across the country to be by his side while he recovered at Walter Reed Medical Center. The financial strain on the family was devastating.

Miraculously, Steven survived and was released from the hospital...

...but Steven still needed round-the-clock care.

He couldn't get out of bed on his own, take a shower without help, never mind live alone.

And with their limited resources, Steven's parents lied awake at night wondering how they'd afford to transform their home to help take care of Steven.

That's when Operation Finally Home stepped in and remodeled the Schulz home with wider doorways and a wheelchair ramp... replaced the carpets with tiles for his wheelchair... overhauled the bathrooms so Steven could be lifted in and out of the tub easily... and so much more.

With faith in God and a servant's heart, Operation Finally Home builds hope through providing or improving homes for America's veterans, first responders, and their families.

And we do that by relying on the generosity of patriotic Americans like you.

Thousands more wounded, ill, and injured veterans and first responders like Steven need your help to live comfortably and affordably. [**Will you help them by making a contribution to Operation Finally Home today?**](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2zuaoqnuqd167dgcamakh82mnnbrpupbiq9k38b80_rp22sh2s8i66pb2c5im1pb4chh2bs)
[> > DONATE TODAY! < <](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2zbfutk0ubqrk188o0afbdiu9no6iogacqupdt1qo_rp22sh2s8i66pb2c5im1pb4chh2bs)
Just like LCpl Steven Schulz's parents agonized over how they'd afford to pay for the home modifications they needed to take care of Steven, Megan Stayskal couldn't fathom what to do when she heard her husband's diagnosis.

U.S. Army SFC Richard Stayskal began his service in 2001 with the Marine Corp where he served as a machine gunner and scout sniper.

While in Iraq, Richard was critically wounded by heavy sniper fire – sustaining a gunshot wound striking his left lung.

Still drawn to serve his country, Stayskal re-enlisted in the U.S. Army a year later where he became a Weapons Sergeant in the Army Special Forces.

But even with all of Richard's bravery and perseverance, his family's life changed forever after he was diagnosed with Stage 3a lung cancer in 2017.

And it got even worse when his diagnosis elevated to terminal Stage 4 about a year later.

With two young daughters, Richard and Megan spent weeks wondering how they'd afford to keep the roof over their heads and food on the table after Richard passed on.

So, Operation Finally Home reached out to the community with an urgent request...

**Help us build and donate a home to the Stayskal family, 100% mortgage free.**

First, a generous patriot in Aberdeen, North Carolina offered to donate the land.

Then, Cushman & Wakefield and Daniel Adams Construction – two local home-building companies – offered to donate their time and expertise.

Finally – and most importantly – hundreds of folks from around the country helped us raise the money needed to pay for the wood, the tools, the tiles, the appliances... everything we needed to build the Stayskal family a brand-new home.

Thanks to the outpouring of love and financial contributions from so many generous Americans, Operation Finally Home built Richard and his family a brand-new home and donated it to them 100% mortgage-free.

Now, Richard and Megan never again have to worry about how they'll keep the roof over their daughters' heads after Richard sadly passes on.

But that's why I'm e-mailing you today, friend.

Right now, thousands more veterans, first responders, and military families are having the same tough conversations... facing the same fears as to how they'll afford to take care of their families with the injuries they sustained fighting for our freedom.

And the only way Operation Finally Home can attempt to ease their pain and stress is with your help.

[**Will you please consider sending Operation Finally Home a gift of $35 or more today to help provide more wounded, ill, and injured veterans and first responders with their very own mortgage-free home?**](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2zn65fq15oi0m9pdvqfrski267df435lp4kg1qigg_rp22sh2s8i66pb2c5im1pb4chh2bs)
[> > DONATE TODAY! < <](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2zmgteovca7im99rtsua7elshgshgcqp53obnalto_rp22sh2s8i66pb2c5im1pb4chh2bs)
As a non-profit organization, every dollar you can afford to give today is tax-deductible.

And every dollar give doesn't just provide a home to a deserving wounded veteran, first responder, or military family.

Your contributions give these heroes the gift of a loving community to remind them every single day just how thankful we are for their sacrifices.

And in the case of heroes like LCpl Steven Schulz and Army SFC Richard Stayskal – you help their families survive after the most unfathomable tragedies strike.

[**I hope that I can count on you to help Operation Finally Home give back to our wounded veterans and first responders.**](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2zpf2r2b8gjogqof45ae6bedpi8bst94a7j52nlr0_rp22sh2s8i66pb2c5im1pb4chh2bs)

God Bless,

Rusty Carroll

[> > DONATE TODAY! < <](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2z37i65l865h3jgn3ujhf13l80bard6jfe4vfgu8o_rp22sh2s8i66pb2c5im1pb4chh2bs)

# Weekly Campaign Update - Get Involved This Weekend!
## Reminder: Today is voter registration deadline!

Friends and supporters,

Guess what? There are only 32 more days left until Election Day on June 14th, and today is the last day to register to vote in person. So make sure to register today if you haven't already.

This week has been full of awesome news, but here's the quick read:
* Brand new polling showing we're maintaining a huge lead!
* We're crossing 30,000 doors knocked this weekend -- you can join up and help!
* Join us at the Dorchester County GOP's Saturday Stump Rally

## Deadline Today: Register to Vote In Person
Today is the deadline for registering to vote, so if you haven't already, [go to SCVotes.gov at this link](https://nancymace.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=f826f615915b06bdee33acac8&id=05713e6af7&e=ddc57b5ede) to get all the information you need to register to vote in person for the June 14 primary election.

## Exciting New Poll Numbers
We have fresh new polling data showing the Mace campaign has a huge lead in the race and is on track to close out these last 32 days with strength.

Voters are telling us:
* They know Nancy Mace has a consistently conservative voting record from her time in both the State House and in Congress.
* They love the fact that Nikki Haley has endorsed Nancy Mace!
* They know that Nancy Mace is the only candidate in this race with a 100% record of voting against tax increases.
* They remember what it was like to lose this seat to a Democrat four years ago, and Nancy Mace is the conservative they trust to keep this seat in Republican hands.

## Nancy In The News This Week
[](https://nancymace.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=f826f615915b06bdee33acac8&id=15fd1dfd08&e=ddc57b5ede)

Congresswoman Mace joined Fox News this week to condemn Joe Biden and the White House for refusing to speak out against liberal protestors who are illegally targeting the homes of Supreme Court justices, attempting to coerce their decisions about overturning Roe v. Wade.

[Watch the full interview on YouTube](https://nancymace.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=f826f615915b06bdee33acac8&id=cd11ccec70&e=ddc57b5ede).

[](https://nancymace.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=f826f615915b06bdee33acac8&id=366d218994&e=ddc57b5ede)
Check out Nancy Mace's [Newsmax interview](https://nancymace.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=f826f615915b06bdee33acac8&id=1c3cf928c2&e=ddc57b5ede) addressing the baby formula shortage.

## Come See Nancy Mace Speak Tomorrow At Dorchester County GOP Event
If you want to meet Congresswoman Mace or just come by and grab a selfie, come on out this Saturday to the Dorchester County Republican Party's "Old Fashion Stump Rally."

Anyone who signs up to knock doors with us gets a free t-shirt. [Sign up here in advance](https://nancymace.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=f826f615915b06bdee33acac8&id=92dd13713b&e=ddc57b5ede) and let us know your shirt size!

Event details:
* Register online here: [Eventbrite link](https://nancymace.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=f826f615915b06bdee33acac8&id=e14a68f0bc&e=ddc57b5ede)
* Sat, May 14 from 1PM to 4PM
* Location: Dorchester County GOP Headquarters
* 104 North Magnolia Street, Summerville 29483 ([Google Map Directions](https://nancymace.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=f826f615915b06bdee33acac8&id=61a07b6da4&e=ddc57b5ede))

## In Case You Missed It: Check Out Our Ad Featuring Former Governor Nikki Haley
[](https://nancymace.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=f826f615915b06bdee33acac8&id=cb24ae0f00&e=ddc57b5ede)

## Join Our Door Knocking Army
Want to add to our momentum and join our team knocking doors in your neighborhood this weekend? [Sign up here](https://nancymace.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=f826f615915b06bdee33acac8&id=8092db23c2&e=ddc57b5ede) and Ashley will help you get set up in our system.

Everyone who knocks doors for us this weekend gets:
* A free Nancy Mace for Congress t-shirt (be sure to tell us your size)
* An invitation to meet Nancy and get a selfie at an event near you

[Just click this link to sign up >>>](https://nancymace.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=f826f615915b06bdee33acac8&id=7854750af9&e=ddc57b5ede)

Join #TeamMace Today!
Our campaign is going full steam ahead going into the June 14 Republican primary. It is important to have a proven conservative with a record we can rely on to represent our Lowcountry values in Washington.

We can't do this without your help! We're building a team of all-star volunteers to help us:
* Be social media ambassadors
* Knock doors
* Make phone calls
* Request yard signs
* Deliver yard signs

If you would like to join our team, [click this link here](https://nancymace.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=f826f615915b06bdee33acac8&id=c4527b5c1e&e=ddc57b5ede) to sign up, and someone will be in touch with you shortly.

Hello
Friend,
Many of
us are familiar with the life and teachings of Jesus Christ. But
have you ever wondered where these amazing stories took place?
In our
fast-paced society, the average American travels about 30 miles a
day. As a result, it can be hard to picture the ministry of
Christ as he walked from town to town and village to village
healing the sick, raising the dead, and giving sight to the
blind.
Jesus
didn't zoom around on the expressway, he walked an average of
about three miles-per-hour, slow enough to minister to everyone
His father put in His path.
To help
you better understand Jesus' area of ministry and the
world-altering impact it had, I created The Jesus Map. It traces
the life and ministry of Jesus Christ, including 52 key events
from His birth in Bethlehem to His ascension on the Mount of
Olives
This
unique reference tool will let you see where he fed the 5,000,
walked on water, and was tempted by Satan. As you walk with
Christ and the Apostles down those dusty Israeli roads, you will
better understand the questions people asked Him and the needs he
confronted.

I pray it
will also inspire you with ways God wants to use you in your area
of influence. Many times, we only need to slow down enough to see
what God has in mind.
Here's
your link to get the map and begin your journey of discovery:
https://ptv.org/nna/the-jesus-map

Let's
walk together along the path of Jesus Christ.

Dr.
Robert Jeffress
Senior
Pastor, First Baptist Dallas

subject: What are Scope 3 emissions exactly?

body:

So far, nearly 3,000 of you signed on—but now Wall Street and Big Polluters are pushing back. [**_We're partnering with 12+ climate orgs to bring the full force of our movement to this fight—will you sign on today?_**](https://act.evergreenaction.com/go/4302?t=3&akid=12971%2E53494%2E8U6nG-)
---

| [TAKE ACTION NOW](https://act.evergreenaction.com/go/4302?t=4&akid=12971%2E53494%2E8U6nG-)
---
Friend,
Right now, public companies aren't required to tell investors about their climate risk—meaning that countless 401(k)s, pensions, and IRAs could be wiped out in a climate disaster.
The SEC just proposed a rule to require companies to disclose their climate vulnerability, greenhouse gas pollution, and their plan to protect investors. This is great progress—but there's a major problem.
The current draft of the rule only requires companies to disclose their Scope 1 and Scope 2 emissions—giving them the chance to keep their Scope 3 emissions hidden. Here's what that means in plain English.
* **Scope 1** emissions are the pollution a company creates in its own operations—the pollution billowing from a factory's smokestacks, for example.
* **Scope 2** emissions are the pollution from the generation of purchased energy. If a factory buys power from a coal plant, the pollution from burning the coal will be accounted for.
* **Scope 3** emissions are the pollution from the rest of the company's activities—including use of the product they create. For example, if the factory in question is producing gasoline, its products will obviously release pollution—but under the current draft rule, they wouldn't have to disclose this.

Scope 3 emissions are often the vast majority of a company's pollution. Leaving disclosure of a large share of companies' pollution up to their own discretion leaves investors in the dark—and all of us vulnerable to a climate-related financial crash.
Luckily, the SEC has opened a public comment period, and we need to show massive support for including Scope 3 emissions in this groundbreaking policy.
[**_Will you join thousands of climate advocates from over a dozen climate groups across the country by signing an official public comment right now? We'll submit it directly to SEC decision-makers!_**](https://act.evergreenaction.com/go/4302?t=5&akid=12971%2E53494%2E8U6nG-)

#### Breaking News
# Michael Brown Shines in First Republican Debate
---
|
---
|
---
| In a wide-ranging debate featuring eight Republican gubernatorial candidates, _Michigan State Police Captain Michael Brown distinguished himself as the candidate who is best positioned to defeat Gretchen Whitmer in November_.

Brown revealed one of the key reasons he decided to run for Governor.

When asked about his reaction to Governor Whitmer utilizing the state police to enforce her lockdown orders, Brown was passionate. He talked about the young men and women under his command who had to struggle with the enforcement orders, and how public respect for law enforcement throughout the state has declined as a result of the Governor's actions.

_"No Governor should ever do that," Brown stated. "And that's a big part of why I'm in this race today."_
---
| [ ](https://captainmikeformichigan.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=d4c9e98e87232d3682c652313&id=1640cd8fcc&e=0636b97700)
---
Lots of good press coverage of the debate.
|
---
| Brown, _the top crime fighter in the race_ , pointed out he was the only candidate who has released [a comprehensive pubic safety plan to protect reduce crime and protect our communities](https://captainmikeformichigan.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=d4c9e98e87232d3682c652313&id=9a7c920da1&e=0636b97700).

Beyond public safety, he displayed a depth of knowledge on issues ranging from education to economics. He strongly advocated for trade school education alongside traditional college education, and promoted access to financial aid for trade schools.

"You can take out hundreds of thousands of dollars in loans to go to U of M," Brown stated. "But you can't get financial aid to go to a trade school. This must change."

Michael Brown is a US Marine Corps veteran having served under President Ronald Reagan. He has a distinguished 34-year career with the Michigan State Police where he currently serves as captain of the southwest division. Throughout his career, Captain Brown helped remove drugs and violent offenders from the streets, working to make communities safer.

He has excelled at developing high performing teams to tackle difficult situations and find solutions. This is the experience he will bring to Michigan as Governor.

It is Brown's thoughtful, common sense, personality that resonates with voters hungry for honest leadership in the Governor's office.

Last night, I had the pleasure of speaking to Tennesseans all across our state, as we participated in the first gubentorial debate of 2022 in Knoxville. Four years ago Governor Lee promised change, yet, Tennesseans still do not have access to quality or affordable healthcare, women and birthing people are having their rights stripped away, we are still criminalizing those with tiny amounts of cannabis, and all across the state our most vulnerable communities are continuing to be used in a twisted match of political football, all while the supermajority gets more radical.
You have my word. I will never run away from the problems facing everyday Tennesseans, and I will never stop working for solutions.

These fights are powerfully important — because here’s what happens when Republican politicians win elections and get their way:
More parents are forced to ration groceries and watch their children go hungry.
More parents are forced to have hushed conversations at the kitchen table after they’ve put their kids to bed — conversations about how on earth they’re going to make rent, pay the mortgage, or cover medical bills.
More parents — especially moms — are forced to give up their careers because child care costs more than their salary.
More parents are forced to make impossible choices between going to work that day so they can buy groceries or staying home so they can take care of a sick child.
More kids are forced to go to under-funded public schools, where some get cruelly punished for having little to no funds in their lunch accounts.
More teachers are forced to deal with red tape that stops them from teaching honest lessons about Black history, or from trying to create safe, welcoming classroom environments for LGBTQ+ students.
More working people and more retirees are forced to struggle to make ends meet and afford life-saving prescription drugs.
All while more billionaires and giant corporations are getting richer. They’re empowered to write their own ticket at tax time — skipping out on the bill while teachers, nurses, and firefighters pay their taxes on time and in full every year to fund schools, hospitals, and highways.
**I’m not willing to accept any of that. So I’m going to do everything I can to keep Republicans out of power in these midterm elections.**
Our Democratic majorities in Congress are razor-thin, and we also need to fight back — hard — in state and local races that the GOP has been focusing on for decades. So I’ve already endorsed dozens of champions for working people up and down the ballot for 2022.

They’re empowered to write their own ticket at tax time — skipping out on the bill while teachers, nurses, and firefighters pay their taxes on time and in full every year to fund schools, hospitals, and highways. I’m not willing to accept any of that. So I’m going to do everything I can to keep Republicans out of power in these midterm elections. Our Democratic majorities in Congress are razor-thin, and we also need to fight back — hard — in state and local races that the GOP has been focusing on for decades. So I’ve already endorsed dozens of champions for working people up and down the ballot for 2022. And I’m asking you to stay in this fight all the way. = Thanks for being a part of this, Elizabeth = | | | | | | ---|---|---|--- | Paid for by Warren Democrats All content © 2022 Warren Democrats, All Rights Reserved PO Box 171375, Boston, MA 02117

name: Lawrence Reed
subject: This is how you and I can save schools from socialism
body:
The teenagers in your life your children, grandchildren, nieces and nephews, your friends’ kids they are in danger of embracing socialism in their schools. [](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/BC.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c210334%7c9086%7c8%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz%7c805&wdmdk=tVZxTJgaRylhwZwKYv%2fhEw&sysid=1)
[](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c21181%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=FqDajqDZwlZlDCpTOCvYfA&sysid=1)

Friend,

The teenagers in your life-your children, grandchildren, nieces and nephews, your friends’ kids... _they are in danger of embracing socialism in their schools_.

If you’re anything like me, you are worried about what’s being taught to our country’s youth.

I have spent my life fighting for liberty, and even risked my life distributing pro-free market books in the Soviet Union, and I am NOT going to give up the future of liberty to misinformed socialist educators.

That’s why the Foundation for Economic Education (FEE) is launching __**Training America’s Teachers**__ to educate teachers about free markets and sound economics over socialism.

I am excited to tell you that FEE is officially teaching Nevada high school economics teachers about free-markets through our program _**Training America’s Teachers**_.

This means the ACTUAL teachers in these high schools will learn...
* How taxes destroy wealth
* What causes inflation and how money-printing destroys the value of our currency
* Why government spending isn’t the solution to a recession
* And why free markets create jobs, unleash innovation, solve problems, and lift millions out of poverty

The best part?

These teachers then educate their classrooms about free markets.

You and I officially have a REAL plan to change the direction of education in the United States. And we’re not stopping in simply one state.

_That’s one state down, 49 to go_. I am looking to raise $50,000 to expand the program throughout the US.

[_**Friend**_ _**, can you help train America’s teachers for the teens in your life, with a donation of $25, $50, $100, or any amount? Click here to donate >>>**_](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c21182%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=DIrdKpEDvfCslkP9%2bINNAg&sysid=1)

Here's how _**Training America’s Teachers**_ works:
* **Classroom materials.** FEE provides resources for high school economics classes that meet curriculum requirements and are easy to use.

* **Online on-demand teacher training modules.** FEE trains teachers on how to use FEE’s Classroom materials and the ideas behind the materials.

* **Live teacher training.** Partnering with our teacher network FEE delivers live training to teachers in 10 states. And we are already working to bring -person teaching and professional development training to additional states as well.

* **Educator outreach, distribution, and marketing.** FEE uses its teacher network and connections with teacher organizations to drive teachers to FEE’s Learning Center and training seminars.

[](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c21181%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=FqDajqDZwlZlDCpTOCvYfA&sysid=1)

FEE partners with state school boards and agencies to help instruct teachers on the official high school economic curriculum.

You and I are changing the hearts and minds of young students by SHOWING them an alternative to socialism. **Young people love the ideas of liberty, entrepreneurship, and independence._But they never heard our message_! **

That changes today.

Can I count on you to support your state, Friend? **Click any link below to donate.**

[_**Donate $10 >>>**_](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c21183%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=B0EEltKnKSdkZfSMkzIoZw&sysid=1)

[_**Donate $50 >>>**_](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c21195%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=S4bg5Otpo8IUFQR25wHFNw&sysid=1)
[_**Donate $100 >>>**_](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c21196%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=8eHiZWM9YJ%2bJeqCGLRkauA&sysid=1)
[_**Donate $250 >>>**_](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c21197%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=65ZxXgAcPiDkuBG9LWSvCg&sysid=1)
[_**Donate $500 >>>**_](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c21198%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=Hqz9Vl3G4kS%2fNanlcMeR2A&sysid=1)
[_**Donate $1000 >>>**_](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c21199%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=Ct2E0QkOvgF5oxT8GK442A&sysid=1)
[_**Donate $2500 >>>**_](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c21190%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=jw3BaPw8fBTvAUxsL6mnzQ&sysid=1)
[_**Donate Any Amount >>>**_](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c21191%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=ZKsfqGdLavWccKyZglNW1g&sysid=1)

Your gift will be used to educate thousands of high school students and teachers across the United States about the ideas of liberty and free market principles.

I am excited to have a REAL plan of action to change the direction of education in the United States. Please consider making the most generous gift you can.

Our goal is to raise $25,000 in the next 72 hours to help fund this project. I hope you will consider donating.

Thank you,

Lawrence Reed
President Emeritus

| **What is William's Position on Banking for All? **
---
Hello My Floridians, As Senator of Florida, William will use his legislative powers to curb the threat of predatory lending, ensure the Consumer Financial Protection Bureau (CFPB) maintains its oversight over lending practices and consumer complaints, remains funded by the Federal Reserve, and properly mandates that lenders comply with the Equal Credit Opportunity Act.Our large banking institutions too often leave too many Americans behind. William will invest in and encourage the development of microfinance institutions throughout the country. He has already demonstrated the success of his plan through the building of his institutions in both South Florida and the Philippines. The establishment of these microfinance institutions ensures that everyone, including historically disadvantaged minority communities, canreceive fair lending from banks that translate into mobility for finding work, opening businesses, and caring for urgent family needs. Dear Fellow American, Young people today grow up being told that their perception of reality is a matter of perspective. Recently, they are even told that women can choose to be men and men women. This denial of objective reality—including a denial of an objective good—is destructive of proper education, of religious faith, and of free government. Largely as an antidote to this destructive force, Hillsdale College is releasing its latest free online course,**“C.S. Lewis on Christianity.”** Taught by Michael Ward, a visiting distinguished fellow at Hillsdale and a professor of theology at Oxford University, this seven-lecture course covers Lewis’s philosophical defense of an objective good and his demonstration of its fulfillment in Christianity. **I am writing today to ask if you would consider****pre-registering for this free online course. You can do so at this secure link:** **** **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/cs-lewis-christianity-preregister/](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zfkimblkb8j2trqntckpsqe7nvni7hd69lrsqs80_rp22sh2s8i66pb2c5hm2o72cdh2bs)** **** **After pre-registering for****“C.S. Lewis on Christianity,” please help us****meet our goal of raising $500,000 by midnight on May 16 to promote this new online course effectively, especially to young people.** **** Hillsdale produces its free online courses, as it does all its work, while refusing to accept government funding—not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans. We are entirely dependent on private donations. With your tax-deductible gift today, we can enroll tens of thousands of young people in this new free online course and expand Hillsdale’s other outreach efforts. Thank you for your friendship and support. Warm regards, Larry P. Arnn President, Hillsdale College Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844

body:
| | | |
---
---
**Melissa Hart endorses Lou Barletta for governor of Pennsylvania**
---
---
_Melissa Hart suspends her campaign and endorses Lou Barletta for governor of Pennsylvania _
---
Former state senator and Member of Congress Melissa Hart today announced that she is withdrawing for the race for governor of Pennsylvania and endorsing Lou Barletta as the Republican candidate. Like fellow former candidate Sen. Jake Corman, Hart is calling on all Republicans to gather behind Barletta as the Republican candidate best situated to win the primary and beat Democrat Josh Shapiro in November. Hart made the announcement in a press conference with Barletta in Harrisburg on Friday morning. The Republican gubernatorial primary is Tuesday, May 17, 2022.
